newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume was 1.6 billion yuan against 1.4 billion on Tuesday, with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said trading was dull, with both banks and non-bank financial institutions doing less business with the approach of the year-end.
The Shanghai Securities News said that the average daily volume on the market was 2.7 billion yuan in November, a drop of 931 million yuan from October.

"All member institutions are trading less with the year-end drawing near," said one trader. "The rates are likely to move in a narrow range on reduced volumes in the short term if there is no major market-moving news."
